text: Sorry to bother you this late. I'm fostering a 2 year old boy, Tyler, and he's 38.9. He's really not himself, all floppy, and I keep having to shake him and say his name before he even looks at me, which isn't like him at all. His breathing seems fine, normal speed, no noises. He also hasn't pooed in three days and he's been grumpy about that. Sorry, I just didn't know who else to ask.
